title: Batuley language
description: Austronesian language spoken in Maluku, Indonesia
extract: Batuley is a language spoken on the Aru Islands of eastern Indonesia. It is close to Mariri. Hughes (1987) estimates that around 80% of lexical items are shared. The language's name comes from the Gwatle island, which the Batuley consider their homeland.
